# Grant's Estate Agents

> Real estate agency serving Casey and Cardinia in Melbourne's south-east — residential sales, rentals, appraisals and local market guides across Berwick, Narre Warren, Pakenham and surrounding suburbs.

## Key pages

- [Properties for sale](https://grantsea.com.au/buy): Current residential listings across Casey and Cardinia
- [Properties for rent](https://grantsea.com.au/rent): Rental listings and open-for-inspection times
- [Sell with us](https://grantsea.com.au/sell): Selling process, recent sales and free property appraisal
- [Our agents](https://grantsea.com.au/agents): Local agent profiles and contact details
- [Suburb guides](https://grantsea.com.au/suburbs): Guides to 20 south-east Melbourne suburbs
- [Advice](https://grantsea.com.au/advice): Buying, selling and renting advice articles

## Top suburb guides

- [Berwick](https://grantsea.com.au/suburbs/berwick): Established family suburb with heritage village centre
- [Narre Warren](https://grantsea.com.au/suburbs/narre-warren): Central Casey hub around Fountain Gate
- [Cranbourne](https://grantsea.com.au/suburbs/cranbourne): Growth corridor suburb with strong affordability
- [Pakenham](https://grantsea.com.au/suburbs/pakenham): Cardinia's major centre with rail to Melbourne CBD
- [Officer](https://grantsea.com.au/suburbs/officer): New estates in the Pakenham growth corridor
